papers.title: Leveraging commitment- and collaboration-oriented human resource management for business model innovation in small-and-medium-sized enterprises: A dual-path perspective of knowledge acquisition and application
papers.abstract: This study investigates the impact of commitment- and collaboration-oriented human resource management (HRM) systems on business model innovation (BMI) in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), drawing on the knowledge-based view (KBV) as well as HRM and BMI literature. The findings reveal that commitment-oriented HRM systems, which focus on fostering internal trust and collaboration, enhance knowledge acquisition pathways, while collaboration-oriented HRM systems promote external knowledge application, enabling BMI through distinct dual paths. The two HRM systems are complementary rather than substitutes, and their combined effect maximizes BMI outcomes.
papers.summary_ja: コミットメント志向と協働志向という2種類のHRMシステムが、それぞれ内部知識獲得と外部知識活用という異なる経路を通じてSMEsのビジネスモデルイノベーション（BMI）を促進することを知識ベースビューで実証。HRM制度設計がBMI成否を規定する組織的前提条件であることを示す。
papers.analysis_unit: 中国のSME192社の質問票調査

papers.title: AI in science: When and where it makes a difference
papers.abstract: Why do some scientific fields benefit far more from AI than others? To answer this question, we study the diffusion and effects of AI across more than 170 scientific fields between 2005 and 2023, drawing on a dataset of over 80 million scientific publications, and assessing its contribution to knowledge creation using indicators of novelty and impact. We find that, on average, the use of AI is associated with increases in both novelty and impact, but that these effects are highly heterogeneous across fields. AI adoption has the strongest positive effects in data-intensive, measurement-driven fields with high proportions of routine tasks, while having minimal effects in theory-driven humanities and social sciences.
papers.summary_ja: 2005〜2023年の8,000万件超の学術論文データを用いて、AIが170以上の科学分野の知識創造（新規性・インパクト）に与える差異的効果を大規模実証分析。データ集約型・測定可能・定型タスク比率の高い分野でAIが最大効果を発揮する一方、理論主導型分野では効果が小さいという分野条件を特定した。
papers.analysis_unit: 170超の科学分野・8,000万件超の学術出版データ（2005-2023年）

papers.title: Flops and Missed Opportunities: The Differential Effect of Distinct Failure Types on Persistence With Underperforming Innovation Projects
papers.abstract: Without recognizing how past failures bias subsequent choices, managers risk decisions that waste resources or prematurely abandon promising opportunities. This study draws on risk-type preference-shift theory and extends it with individual and organizational boundary conditions to examine how distinct failure experiences shape managers' willingness to persist with underperforming innovation projects. Findings reveal asymmetric effects: flop experiences (premature failures) generate excessive risk aversion and early exit bias, while missed opportunity experiences (late exits from viable projects) generate persistence bias. These asymmetric patterns are moderated by failure-tolerant organizational culture and individual risk attitudes.
papers.summary_ja: 「早すぎる失敗（フロップ）」と「遅すぎる撤退（見逃した機会）」という2種類の失敗経験が管理者のイノベーションプロジェクト継続意欲に与える非対称な効果をリスク選好変化理論で実証。フロップ経験は過剰なリスク回避バイアスを、機会損失経験は固執バイアスを生む非対称パターンを特定した。
papers.analysis_unit: マネジャーを対象とした定量分析（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Creative Control in Designer-AI Co-Creation with Design Experience as a Boundary Condition
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly involved in creative processes, designers encounter a fundamental tension regarding creative control—the degree to which they dominate design direction and iterative decision-making when collaborating with AI. Existing theories offer contradictory predictions: self-determination and psychological ownership theories emphasize the benefits of high control, while cognitive load theory suggests excessive control hinders creativity. This study empirically tests these competing predictions, finding that creative control has a curvilinear (inverted U-shape) effect on co-creation outcomes, with design experience as a key boundary condition moderating the optimal level of control.
papers.summary_ja: デザイナーとGenerative AIの共創においてクリエイティブコントロールの高さが創造性を高める場合と阻害する場合があることを実証し、デザイン経験レベルが境界条件として機能することを特定。AI協働ワークフロー設計でスキルレベル別の最適コントロール度を設定する必要性を示す。
papers.analysis_unit: デザイナーとAIの共創に関する実証研究（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: Cognitive Implications of Using GenAI in Design Thinking: Insights From Educational Case Studies
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping knowledge-intensive industries, requiring knowledge workers to adapt and, at times, reinvent their practices. Educating the next generation of knowledge workers in this rapidly evolving era of GenAI requires higher education to prepare students for this new work environment by incorporating GenAI-augmented practices into the educational process. This study examines cognitive implications of using GenAI in design thinking workflows through educational case studies, finding that GenAI integration increases ideation diversity but reduces critical evaluation capacity, and that facilitator role redesign is essential for effective GenAI-augmented design thinking.
papers.summary_ja: GenAIをデザイン思考の各フェーズに統合した教育事例研究で、アイデア量・多様性の増大と批判的評価能力の低下という二律背反的な認知効果を実証。GenAI時代のデザイン思考教育再設計とファシリテーター役割変容の方向性を提示した。
papers.analysis_unit: 高等教育におけるGenAI活用デザイン思考の教育事例研究（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: Sustainability experiment led by city government: Lessons from Shenzhen's waste management
papers.abstract: This study examines a sustainability experiment led by the Shenzhen city government in waste management, analyzing the institutional conditions that enable city governments to initiate and sustain transition experiments. Unlike bottom-up niche experiments, government-led experiments mobilize top-down institutional authority while requiring bottom-up stakeholder engagement. The study identifies three key success factors: strong institutional commitment, adaptive governance mechanisms, and multi-stakeholder co-design. Lessons from Shenzhen inform transition theory and urban sustainability governance practice.
papers.summary_ja: 深圳市政府が主導する廃棄物管理の持続可能性実験を分析し、都市政府がトランジション実験のイニシエーターとなる際の成功条件（制度的コミットメント・適応型ガバナンス・マルチステークホルダー共創）を解明。政府主導型実験の特有の制度的ダイナミクスを社会技術移行理論に組み込む貢献をした。
papers.analysis_unit: 深圳市政府主導の廃棄物管理実験1件の事例研究

papers.title: Mapping artificial intelligence research in the cultural and creative industries: A systematic bibliometric review
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping creativity, labor, and authorship in the cultural and creative industries (CCIs), yet management and innovation scholarship on this transformation remains fragmented and theoretically underdeveloped. This bibliometric review addresses two interrelated gaps and maps the intellectual structure and thematic evolution of AI research in CCIs from a management and innovation perspective, identifying three main research clusters: redefining creativity, transforming labor and authorship, and evolving business models. The review highlights significant research gaps and proposes a future research agenda for management scholars.
papers.summary_ja: 文化・クリエイティブ産業（CCI）におけるAI研究の知的構造を体系的文献計量レビューで整理し、「創造性の再定義」「労働・著作権変容」「ビジネスモデル進化」の3クラスターを特定。統合理論の構築が急務であることを示し、管理・イノベーション研究者向けの未来研究アジェンダを提示した。
papers.analysis_unit: 文献計量レビュー（対象文献数の記載なし）

papers.title: Strategy Jams: using design thinking to charter teams with compelling purpose and sound structure
papers.abstract: It is unclear how science facilitators can balance the amount of structure, content, and freedom they give to teams in chartering workshops. We propose that design thinking principles and activities can fill this need in team science. We piloted a team chartering workshop based on design thinking (a “Strategy Jam”) with five hybrid research/research support teams. We tracked chartering outcomes and what led to them using a mixed methods, explanatory, longitudinal study design. Data were collected using the Team Diagnostic Survey and interviews with team leaders. Immediately after the Strategy Jam, teams’ scores for their compelling purpose increased by an average of 13%. For three of the four teams measured quantitatively, their sound structure scores increased by an average of 8% while one team’s score decreased by 11%. Qualitative analysis of interviews with all five teams revealed that design thinking factors were influential, along with contextual factors and generic factors common to any participatory workshop. An unknown follow up mechanism likely contributed to further gains and losses in chartering outcomes over time. In this pilot study, design thinking was an effective and efficient way to design a participatory chartering workshop. It was effective because it helped charter team purpose and structure along with team commitment, learning, and cohesion. It was efficient because a design thinking approach fulfilled five science facilitation functions at once: (1) structure the participation process, (2) structure the workshop process, (3) facilitate generic workshop factors (e.g., aligned choosing), (4) gain traction on chartering topics for ambiguous challenges, and (5) respond to context.
papers.summary_ja: デザイン思考を用いたチームチャーター策定ワークショップ「ストラテジー・ジャム」を5チームで試行したパイロット研究。目的（compelling purpose）スコアは平均13%上昇した一方、構造（sound structure）スコアは定量測定した4チーム中3チームで平均8%上昇・1チームは11%低下した。対照群が無く著者自身も信頼性の限界を明記しているため、効果は示唆にとどまる。構造と自由度のバランスをデザイン思考で設計する手法として参考になる。
papers.analysis_unit: 研究・研究支援チーム5チームのパイロット研究（うち定量測定は4チーム）

papers.title: Systems-Based Organisational Resilience Framework: A Delphi Study-Based Validation and Verification
papers.abstract: The increasing systemic complexity of the Fourth Industrial Revolution has heightened the need for robust approaches to organisational resilience. Despite its growing prominence, resilience research remains fragmented, with limited consensus on core dimensions, causal interdependencies and mechanisms suitable for dynamic assessment. This study addresses these gaps by developing and validating a Systems-Based Organisational Resilience Framework (SORF) through a Delphi study methodology, achieving expert consensus on core resilience dimensions, interdependencies, and dynamic assessment mechanisms applicable to complex sociotechnical organizations.
papers.summary_ja: 第四次産業革命の複雑性増大に対応する組織レジリエンス・フレームワークをデルファイ法で開発・検証。コア次元・因果的相互依存性・動態的評価メカニズムを統合したシステムベースの枠組みを提示し、複雑な社会技術システムを運営する企業の危機対応能力構築に実践的ツールを提供した。
papers.analysis_unit: デルファイ法による専門家合意形成（専門家数の記載なし）

papers.title: Navigating Uncertainty in Advanced Air Mobility: Scenario Planning for Policy Pathways at San Francisco International Airport
papers.abstract: Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) includes innovative aviation technologies and services that could alter how people and goods are transported. However, future AAM growth and potential regional integration are uncertain and influenced by a range of factors. In this paper, we report findings from expert interviews (n = 35) and a scenario planning workshop (n = 32 stakeholders), conducted between August 2024 and January 2025, to map policy pathways for AAM integration at San Francisco International Airport. We identify four scenario archetypes based on two key uncertainty axes (regulatory environment and technology readiness) and derive actionable policy implications for each scenario.
papers.summary_ja: 先進航空モビリティ（AAM）のSFO空港統合に向け、35名の専門家インタビューと32名参加のシナリオ計画ワークショップを組み合わせ、規制環境×技術成熟度の2軸で4つのシナリオ原型を構築し政策経路を提示。新興技術×規制不確実性の高い領域での戦略的フォーサイトとシナリオ計画手法の実践的参照事例となる。
papers.analysis_unit: 専門家インタビュー35名とシナリオプランニングワークショップ（ステークホルダー32名）
